block.telegram.model.title: Telegram
block.telegram.model.description: Send messages and receive updates with a Telegram bot.
block.telegram.security_hint: The bot token stays in the wallet. Only allowlisted chats can be reached or heard.
block.telegram.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.telegram.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.telegram.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, nothing is sent and no update is polled.
block.telegram.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding the bot token from BotFather, never the token itself.
block.telegram.help_allowed_chat_ids: JSON array of numeric chat IDs, e.g. [123456789, -1001234567890]. Sends to other chats are refused and their updates are dropped.
block.telegram.help_default_chat_id: Chat used when an input gives no chat_id. It must also be allowed. Leave empty to require chat_id.
block.telegram.help_parse_mode: none sends plain text. MarkdownV2 and HTML require Telegram's escaping rules; invalid markup is rejected by Telegram.
block.telegram.help_file_root: Only regular files inside this directory can be sent from the file input. Empty disables file sending.
block.telegram.help_file_mode: auto sends JPEG/PNG files up to 10 MiB as photos and everything else as documents.
block.telegram.help_receive_updates: Active Runtime only: long-poll getUpdates from Run until Stop. One Shot never polls.
block.telegram.help_update_types: Subset of ["message", "edited_message", "channel_post", "edited_channel_post"]. Other update types are dropped.
block.telegram.help_poll_timeout_sec: Seconds Telegram may hold one getUpdates call open when no message is waiting.
block.telegram.help_disable_notification: Default for sent messages and files; recipients get no notification sound.
block.telegram.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one send, including upload and retries after HTTP 429. Ambiguous sends are never retried.
block.telegram.help_max_retries: Only rate-limited sends, which Telegram did not process, are retried.
block.telegram.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A retry_after above this value returns a rate_limited error instead of waiting.
block.telegram.help_max_file_bytes: Upper bound for one uploaded file; Telegram accepts at most 50 MiB for documents and 10 MiB for photos.
block.telegram.help_max_response_bytes: Larger Telegram responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.telegram.help_poll_limit: Page size of one getUpdates call. Following pages are fetched with the next offset.
block.telegram.help_max_updates_per_minu: Bursts of up to 10. Extra messages stay on Telegram (24 hours at most) until the budget allows them.
block.telegram.help_api_base_url: Keep https://api.telegram.org. Another HTTPS origin receives the bot token; plain HTTP is accepted only for a loopback test host.
block.telegram.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
